5.name: Episode 1
5.overview: What begins as a blood feud (thar) against a Nukhba terrorist who fled to Marseille—gets complicated. The team reunites and is drawn into a dangerous operation to thwart a major incident that comes from an unexpected direction.

5.name: Episode 2
5.overview: Eli and Doron set out to capture another terrorist from the cell in Nahuba. Steve unexpectedly joins them and brings up the lingering tensions between him and Doron from that cursed day.

5.name: Episode 3
5.overview: Doron's actions lead to a head-on clash between the gang, Dana, and the authorities. Gabi, who is summoned to Marseille, tries to mediate between the sides. Hamas activists are pressuring the authorities to apprehend the culprits.

5.name: Episode 4
5.overview: Doron and Eli are trying to blend in with Hamas. Dana is pressuring Naama to take Steve under her wing. Ann is demanding that Masayid join the operation

5.name: Episode 5
5.overview: Doron, Eli, and the rest of the recruits are kidnapped by a mysterious group on their way to a training camp in Syria. Back in Israel, Gabi and Dana try to figure out who is behind the kidnapping.

5.name: Episode 6
5.overview: Doron and Eli learn the details of the deadly attack that Said and his men are planning. Steve and Anat meet again after two years of being out of touch.

5.name: Episode 7
5.overview: Back to October 7. We are introduced for the first time to the horrific events that shook the lives of Eli, Doron, Steve, and the entire country.

5.name: Episode 8
5.overview: Continuation of the events of October 7. Hagit, Yosef, and the children try to escape from the house infested with terrorists, while Doron, Steve, and Eli are on their way to rescue them.

5.name: Episode 9
5.overview: Said, Ann, and the other terrorists are regrouping to carry out an attack in Israel. Doron is being questioned on suspicion of collaboration. The Shin Bet is launching an operation to locate the terrorists who are already in Israel.

5.name: Episode 10
5.overview: Said is leading the terrorists toward Israeli territory. Gabi and Steve set out on a rescue mission for Doron, who is still listed as out of contact. Anne is facing the most dramatic decision of her life.

5.name: Episode 11
5.overview: Against the backdrop of Memorial Day events, Saeed continues to manipulate the Israeli system and prepares to carry out his murderous plot. Doron and Gabi pressure Anne to help them thwart it.

overview: Fauda (در زبان عربی به معنای آشوب)، داستان دو طرفه درگیری بین اسرائیل و فلسطین را نشان می دهد. دارن، فرمانده نیروهای مخفی اسرائیل، در حال برنامه ریزی یک عملیات گسترده است...

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A top Israeli agent comes out of retirement to hunt for a Palestinian fighter he thought he'd killed, setting a chaotic chain of events into motion.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Doron teams up with his former undercover unit when an old enemy who has targeted him for revenge also launches a more ambitious covert plan.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Doron ensnares a determined young boxer when a months-long covert mission puts the team on the trail of a Hamas leader high on Shin Bet's wanted list.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Doron and his former squad venture on a mission abroad when new enemies nursing old resentments strike at the heart of Shin Bet's operations.
